reason: Document A tells me about the no-contract, cancel-anytime terms, the 15-minute call with the dietitian, and the weekly meal swaps. For someone who has quit three services, those are what make a $59 trial feel low-risk, and A is plain about the limits of the A1C data. Document B leaves out those reassurances, says without evidence that people stay because the food is good, and still shows an unfilled "[day/time]" placeholder, which makes me trust it less.
